title: Quantification of Extracted DNA Using the Quantus Fluorometer with QuantiFluor® dsDNA System
author: Promega
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ihgcb3w

steps.title: Prepare QuantiFluor dsDNA working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the QuantiFluor dsDNA dye at a 1:200 ratio in 1X TE buffer in an empty 0.5ml PCR tube and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 10µl of QuantiFluor dsDNA dye to 1990µl of 1X TE buffer.
Pulse vortex the solution for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Prepare Blank solution for calibration
steps.instruction: Prepare a blank solution in an empty 0.5ml PCR tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 100μl of QuantiFluor dsDNA dye working solution.

steps.title: Prepare standard sample
steps.instruction: Prepare a standard sample in an empty 0.5ml PCR tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 2μl of provided DNA standard to 98μl of 1X TE buffer and mix.
Add 100μl of QuantiFluor dsDNA dye working solution and mix.

steps.title: Calibrate the Quantus fluorometer
steps.instruction: Calibrate the Quantus fluorometer by reading the blank and standard samples.

steps.title: Dilute unknown sample
steps.instruction: Dilute the unknown sample in an empty 0.5ml PCR tube and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 1μl of the unknown sample to 99μl of 1X TE buffer.
Pulse vortex the solution for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Add dye to unknown sample
steps.instruction: Add dye to the diluted unknown sample and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 100μl of QuantiFluor dsDNA dye working solution to the 0.5ml PCR tube (total volume 200μl).
Pulse vortex the solution for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixed solution at room temperature for 5 minutes, protecting it from light.

steps.title: Measure unknown sample concentration
steps.instruction: Configure the Quantus fluorometer and measure the sample.

substeps.instruction: Set the fluorometer to the dsDNA protocol.
Select the unknown sample volume (1μl) and the desired concentration units.
Measure the concentration of the unknown sample.
